## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight—or at least give yourself a little space to think through your options? If quitting is truly what you need, I’ll support you, but you deserve to make that choice with a plan rather than in the middle of a terrible day.

## 2

I understand why some space images might seem hard to trust—photos can be edited, and institutions can make mistakes. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on any single photograph. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different parts of the world, lunar eclipses show Earth’s round shadow, and people and planes can travel continuously around the planet. Independent observations by sailors, scientists, schools, and space agencies all agree. It’s reasonable to question evidence, but the flat-Earth explanation would have to account for all of these observations at once.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules in the air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky. That is why the sky usually looks blue. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue before the light reaches us, leaving more reds and oranges.

## 4

雨落在夜色里，像无数细小的针，轻轻敲打着窗玻璃。街灯被水汽晕开，昏黄的光铺在湿漉漉的路面上，映出摇曳的树影。远处偶尔驶过一辆车，轮胎溅起水花，转眼又消失在巷口。屋檐下的风带着泥土和青草的气息，房间里却安静而温暖。听着绵延不绝的雨声，城市仿佛暂时放慢了脚步，只剩夜色、灯光和一颗适合回忆的心。
